input.rationale: Article III (p0048) gives Licensor ownership of all Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein, and "DERIVATIVE WORK" (p0005) sweeps in any additions, modifications, improvements or enhancements. The customization work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087) — a unique client front end and other enhancements — therefore vests entirely in Licensor, while our only right is the non-exclusive, Field-of-Use licence that cannot be modified or sublicensed (p0042, p0044, p0047, p0085) and terminates outright on termination with a return obligation (p0138). That fails the IP fallback: we receive no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense what we paid for. Licensor's retained ownership of its own platform, tools and know-how is acceptable and is left untouched; no Customer IP or data is assigned to Licensor, and there is no standing Licensor licence in our data, so we have simply confirmed that any such licence is confined to processing to provide the services. We have drafted to the fallback rather than reversing ownership, to avoid collateral rewrites of Articles II, III, VI and XXI.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense customization work we pay for, and limit any Licensor licence in our data to processing to provide the services.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We pay for the unique client front end and other customization work under Article VII(b), but Article III leaves all of it (and any Derivative Work) with Licensor with no licence back that survives termination. We have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense that work for our business, and a limit confining any Licensor licence in our data to processing it to provide the services.

ops.text: CUSTOMIZATION DELIVERABLES. Notwithstanding the foregoing and the restrictions in Articles II and VI and the termination of licenses under Article XXI, Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense, for Licensee's business, all development and customization work performed for Licensee under Article VII(b) (the "Customization Deliverables"). Any license granted to Licensor in data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Licensee is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
